Online Guitar Tuner

Tune your guitar with real pitch detection — the mic listens, autocorrelation finds your note, and the needle shows how many cents sharp or flat you are.

Microphone access is required. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

📖 How to use

  1. Click “Enable microphone” and allow access.
  2. Select a string (or let it auto-detect).
  3. Play the string — watch the needle and cents readout.
  4. Tune until the needle centers and turns green.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is this real pitch detection?

Yes — it uses autocorrelation on the microphone signal, a genuine pitch-detection algorithm.

Which tuning is supported?

Standard tuning E2–A2–D3–G3–B3–E4. Click a string button, then play that string.

How do I know when I'm in tune?

A needle gauge shows cents sharp/flat (±50¢) plus the detected frequency in Hz.

Why does it need the microphone?

Your browser will ask for microphone permission. If denied, the tool explains how to re-enable it.
